questions.question: The archaeologist ______ discovered the ancient stelae at Axum presented his research findings at the international conference.
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'who' refers to a human antecedent ('archaeologist') functioning as the subject of the relative clause.

questions.question: Although defining civilization remains a contested topic among anthropologists, it provides a useful framework for study. What is the closest contextual meaning of 'contested'?
questions.explanation: In Section 2C.1, 'contested' contextually means disputed, debated, or argued about among scholars.

questions.question: During our long-distance telephone conversation, bad weather caused the line to suddenly ______ before we could finish talking.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'cut off' means to interrupt or disconnect a telephone connection unexpectedly.

questions.question: I would rather visit historical heritage sites ______ spend my vacation shopping in crowded modern malls.
questions.explanation: The grammatical structure 'would rather + base verb... than + base verb' is used to express preference between two choices.

questions.question: Which of the following words contains the English diphthong sound /aɪ/ as in 'light'?
questions.explanation: 'Fight' [faɪt] contains the diphthong /aɪ/. 'Make' has /eɪ/, 'town' has /aʊ/, and 'pair' has /eə/.

questions.question: By the time the museum guide arrived at the ancient rock-hewn church, the tour group ______ waiting for nearly an hour.
questions.explanation: When an ongoing duration occurred before a specified point in past time ('arrived'), the Past Perfect Continuous ('had been') is required.

questions.question: The historian stated, 'The Incan Empire had a complex social hierarchy.' In reported speech: The historian stated that the Incan Empire ______ a complex social hierarchy.
questions.explanation: When reporting direct speech with a past reporting verb ('stated'), Simple Past verbs ('had') backshift to Past Perfect ('had had').

questions.question: The senior anthropologist with ______ I discussed the features of ancient Egyptian civilization published a new textbook.
questions.explanation: When a relative pronoun follows a preposition ('with'), formal standard English requires 'whom' for human antecedents.

questions.question: In early urban settlements, agricultural production yielded a surplus that allowed specialized artisans to thrive. What does 'surplus' mean in this context?

options.text: An amount or quantity greater than what is needed
A severe food shortage or drought
A compulsory financial tax paid to rulers
A rapid loss of soil fertility

questions.explanation: Contextually in Unit 2, 'surplus' refers to an excess amount of food or goods produced beyond immediate subsistence consumption needs.

questions.question: The museum curator shouted, 'Do not touch the ancient museum artifacts!' In reported speech: The curator told the visitors ______ the ancient museum artifacts.
questions.explanation: Negative orders in reported speech follow the pattern 'tell + object + not to + base verb' ('told the visitors not to touch').

questions.question: Aster prefers studying ancient Ethiopian history ______ watching contemporary action movies.
questions.explanation: The verb 'prefer' takes the preposition 'to' when comparing two gerunds or nouns ('prefers studying... to watching...').

questions.question: The local stonecutters ______ on the monument for several months before the kingdom's treasury ran out of funds.
questions.explanation: An action that was ongoing over a duration prior to a specific completed past event ('ran out') requires the Past Perfect Continuous ('had been working').

questions.question: Worku said, 'I will present my report on ancient calendars tomorrow.' In reported speech: Worku said that he would present his report on ancient calendars ______.
questions.explanation: In reported speech with a past reporting verb ('said'), future time adverbs like 'tomorrow' shift to 'the following day' or 'the next day'.

questions.question: According to the reading passage 'Features of Contemporary Civilization', why is the Incan Empire cited as a unique historical case study?

options.text: It maintained a complex government, architecture, and art without possessing a written language system.
It was the first civilization to invent the 365-day Gregorian solar calendar.
It relied entirely on nomadism and rejected permanent urban settlements.
It was ruled by foreign European invaders throughout its entire existence.

questions.explanation: Section 2C.1 (Paragraph 4) notes that the Incan Empire was a large civilization with government, architecture, and art, but lacked a written language, illustrating why defining 'civilization' is challenging.

questions.question: Select the sentence that demonstrates CORRECT punctuation and relative pronoun usage in a non-defining relative clause:

options.text: Lalibela, which is famous for its eleven monolithic rock-hewn churches, attracts thousands of pilgrims every year.
Lalibela that is famous for its eleven monolithic rock-hewn churches attracts thousands of pilgrims every year.
Lalibela, that is famous for its eleven monolithic rock-hewn churches, attracts thousands of pilgrims every year.
Lalibela which is famous for its eleven monolithic rock-hewn churches, attracts thousands of pilgrims every year.

questions.explanation: Non-defining relative clauses provide extra non-essential information about a proper noun ('Lalibela'), must be set off by commas, and use 'which' (never 'that') for non-human antecedents.
